
## Which file to download

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `GrabLine-<version>-arm64-v8a.apk` | Most phones from the last eight years |
| `GrabLine-<version>-armeabi-v7a.apk` | Older 32-bit phones |
| `GrabLine-<version>-x86_64.apk` | Emulators and some Chromebooks |
| `GrabLine-<version>-universal.apk` | Any phone, if you are not sure (larger) |

Or open [grabline.github.io](https://grabline.github.io/) on your phone and it picks the right file. Android 8 or later. Every release is signed with the same key, so it installs over the previous version. Check a file against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
